startTime.name: startTime
startTime.description: The specific point in time to start filtering records. This parameter ensures that only data entries timestamped on or after this value are returned. The value must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). This is crucial for pagination, historical data analysis, and synchronization logic.

schema.title: Start Timestamp
schema.description: An ISO 8601 UTC date-time string representing the inclusive start bound of the time range.

startOfFiscalYear.description: Example timestamp representing the beginning of a fiscal year.

oneWeekAgo.description: Example timestamp for a relative lookback period.

endTime.name: endTime
endTime.description: The specific point in time to stop filtering records. This parameter ensures that only data entries timestamped before or at this value are returned. The value must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. If omitted, the server typically defaults to the current timestamp.

schema.title: End Timestamp
schema.description: An ISO 8601 UTC date-time string representing the inclusive end bound of the time range.

endOfFiscalYear.description: Example timestamp representing the end of a fiscal year.

now.description: Example timestamp representing the current moment.

timeZone.name: timeZone
timeZone.description: The IANA time zone identifier to apply when interpreting the 'startTime' and 'endTime' parameters if they are provided without explicit offset information, or for aggregating data by day/month boundaries. Defaults to UTC if not specified.
